items.title: Kyler Murray: Dealing with Grade 2 strain
items.description:
Murray (hamstring) is recovering from a Grade 2 strain "that will keep him out for Monday's game and potentially beyond," Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Terrance Ferguson: Suffers hamstring injury, out again
items.description:
Ferguson (ankle) was expected to return for Sunday's game against Washington, but he's been ruled out after injuring his hamstring during Friday's practice, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
